_comment: MCP servers for the dev-team dev environment. Secrets are NOT stored in this file — they are read from the shell environment, which is populated from ~/dev-team/shared/credentials/.env by the block in ~/.bashrc. This means: (1) rotate keys in .env only, (2) never edit this file for a key change, (3) always launch your harness from a shell that has sourced .bashrc.

github._purpose: GitHub official MCP server (repos, issues, PRs, code search, actions). Runs in Docker. Reads GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN from shell env.

polygon._purpose: Polygon.io market data. Reads POLYGON_API_KEY from shell env.

alpaca_backup._purpose: Alpaca trading — paper by default via PAPER=True. Reads ALPACA_* from shell env.

redis._purpose: Redis operations. Reads REDIS_URL from shell env (defaults to redis://localhost:6379).

docker._purpose: Container operations — start/stop, compose, logs. Requires Docker daemon running.

playwright._purpose: Headless-browser automation. First run downloads browsers (~300MB).

graphify._purpose: Graphify knowledge-graph queries (query_graph, get_node, get_neighbors, god_nodes, graph_stats, shortest_path, PR blast-radius). The server is served per-project: it loads <project>/graphify-out/graph.json. Point it at the right graph via the env block below — GRAPHIFY_PROJECT_DIR for the project, or GRAPHIFY_GRAPH_JSON for an explicit graph.json path. No API key needed.
graphify._http_transport: For a shared/deployment HTTP endpoint, launch instead: GRAPHIFY_API_KEY=... graphify-mcp --transport http --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080. The stdio launcher above is the default for per-developer harnesses.
graphify._build_hint: If no graph exists yet, build one first: cd <project> && graphify update <project> (creates <project>/graphify-out/graph.json; re-run after big changes, or 'graphify watch <project>' to rebuild on edit).
